name: Low Cost Vet Mobile (Animal Adoption Vet Center)
region_note: LOW-COST VET CARE AND SPAY/NEUTER - in the city. From the Mayor's Alliance spay/neuter and reduced-cost vet lists; each checked on its own site 2026-11-03. Ask what it will cost before booking.
notes: 159-19 Horace Harding Expressway (westbound service road of the Long Island Expressway), Fresh Meadows, NY 11365. The QM4 and QM44 express buses run there from across the city. Read the conditions on its website before calling: it sets out rules for who it will serve.
